scope: the fourteen repositories in the task (rea, caveman, leanrea, strix, ponytail, my-jev, pi durable, absurd, laya-coreml, laya, orca, t3code, pandacode, agent-sandbox-lockdown) and RE4exa itself, at their commits of 20 October 2026.
method: Inert rqs probes collected evidence. Ten independent reviewer agents scored every applicable criterion with file:line evidence, recorded gaps and opportunities, and decided each red line. A blind second reviewer re-scored 16 criteria on three targets, and RE4exa got an adversarial review. Static review only: nothing in the targets was built or run.
headlines: No target reaches grade B. The mean Quality Index is 48.4 and the mean Horizon Readiness 5.6; 4 of 886 criterion levels are at the 2030-35 horizon.

The widest gaps are dated obligations: regulatory readiness averages 0.69 of 5 and support commitments 1.08, while EU CRA reporting applies since 11 Sep 2026 and its main obligations from 11 Dec 2027.
All four agent harnesses (orca, t3code, pandacode, pi durable) start agents with broad powers by default; least agency averages 1.86.
Of 148 gaps, the most frequent are claims without evidence (24) and supply chain and CI (24).
Only RE4exa had confirmed red lines: no licence, and SQL names taken from imported files. The second is fixed; the licence is the owner's decision.
Reviewers agree with each other closely (weighted kappa 0.80 on 47 pairs). Automatic suggestions match reviewers exactly 49% of the time and within one level 91%.
agreement_note: Pairs are criteria both reviewers scored 0-5. Kappa is quadratic-weighted; with 15-16 pairs per target it is a rough figure.
footer: RQS-2030 v1.1.0. Reviews dated 2026-10-20. Source data: research/rqs-review in the RE4exa repository.
